TRAFFIC ADVISORY FOR ABUJA RESIDENTS 

PROJECTS COMMISSIONING IN THE FCT (APO-WASA ROAD) DAY 3 - FRIDAY, 13TH JUNE, 2025

The FCT motoring public is again notified of the commissioning of the newly constructed left-hand service carriageway of the Outer Southern Expressway (OSEX) Stage II from Ring
Road I junction to Wasa Junction.

Accordingly, there will be road closure/diversion of traffic at the following points:

(A) Old Road (Apo - Wasa)
Traffic on the old road will be from 1100hrs at Oladipo Diya, Kabusa 1 junction, Kabusa 2 junction (Apo primary school).

(B) New Road (from Bridge near Gudu Cemetry - Wasa)
(i) Total closure from the bridge near the Gudu Cemetery as point 1
ii) Apo Resettlement Junction/Dankogi Filling Station, The Apo Mechanic Village, Pigba and Efab Sunshine Estate.
Alternative routes

The lokogoma road, Oladipo Diya road, and other roads not connecting to the old road can be utilized. The Apo mechanic market will be closed completely for the period of the event.
As usual, your cooperation and patience are highly solicited. Security agencies will be on ground to monitor and direct motorists appropriately.

- Head Traffic, DRTS
